## Problem and behavior

Describe the observed guest failure and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the relevant tests and the actual Chrome result. Distinguish typechecking, startup, menu and gameplay verification.

## Windows contract

For runtime changes, link the Windows API or PE-format contract. Use generic behavior rather than game-specific checks or invented success values.

## Scope

Record the remaining blocker. Do not include game assets, accounts, saves, private runtime logs or local captures.

## Credits

Preserve upstream attribution and the project credits in CREDITS.md.
